title: BIBS Baby Bottles Recalled Due to Burn Hazard; Manufactured by BIBS Denmark ApS
summary: Hot liquids in the bottle can cause the bumper to shrink, making the bottle tilt over spilling out contents, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 300.

title: Children's Robes Recalled Due to Burn Hazard; Imported by NewCosplay
summary: The children's robes fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 3,160.

title: Linum Home Textiles Recalls Children's Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard
summary: The children's robes fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 44,600.

title: Santa Cruz Bicycles Recalls Heckler 9 Electric Bicycles Due to Fall and Fire Hazards
summary: The latch mechanism that holds the battery in place can malfunction, causing the battery to dislodge from the frame and fall to the ground, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Additionally, the latch spring can cause additional wear on the battery housing over time, posing a fire hazard. Units: About

title: Winter Water Factory Recalls Infant French Terry Jumpsuits, Rompers, Snap Suits, Baby Dresses and Bibs Due to Choking and Laceration Hazards
summary: The snaps on the recalled garments can detach and also expose small sharp prongs, posing choking and laceration hazards to young children. Units: About 46,500 (In addition, about 169 were sold in Canada).

title: WizWheelz Recalls GreenSpeed Magnum Recumbent Trikes with Quick Release Axles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The recalled recumbent trikes front axles were improperly assembled during manufacturing. The axles can come loose during use, causing the rider to lose control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 340.

title: DGL Group Recalls Hover-1 Superfly Hoverboards Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: A software malfunction in the electrical system can continue to provide assistance to the motor, causing continued momentum, when the rider is not actively controlling the hoverboard, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 93,000.

title: Moderne Glass Company Recalls Coffee Cups Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The coffee cup can crack or break when hot water is poured into it, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 2,500.

title: Yamaha Recalls Wolverine RMAX Off-Road Side-By-Side Vehicles Due to Fire and Explosion Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled vehicles can have a damaged fuel tank causing fuel to leak, posing fire and explosion hazards. Units: About 4,130.

title: Asweets Recalls Wonder & Wise Activity Tables Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Screws can become loose and/or detach from the xylophone component of the activity tables, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,000.

title: Copper Pearl Recalls Children's Sleepwear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard
summary: The children's pajamas fail to meet the tight-fitting flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,300.

title: Free Birdees Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The children's pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,530.
